output.title: Biallelic variants in genes previously associated with dominant inheritance: CACNA1A, RET and SLC20A2.
Intrafamilial neurological phenotypic variability due to either biallelic or monoallelic pathogenic variants in CACNA1A.
Biallelic CACNA1A mutations cause early onset epileptic encephalopathy with progressive cerebral, cerebellar, and optic nerve atrophy.
Biallelic CACNA1A variants: review of literature and report of a child with drug-resistant epilepsy and developmental delay.
